question: For CIP-004-7 R4, where do my documents commit me to more than the standard requires? Quote the standard's requirement and my document's stronger commitment side by side, and cite both.
answer:
Your documents commit you to a more frequent review interval for certain access types than the standard requires. Specifically, while the standard allows for a 15-month interval for electronic access verification, your work instruction mandates a quarterly review for both electronic and physical access, including BCSI access.

The following comparison highlights the increased frequency in your internal procedures:

| Requirement / Duty | NERC CIP-004-7 R4 (Standard) | LSPG Electronic and Physical Access Review Work Instruction (Operator) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Review Interval** | "For electronic access, verify at least once every 15 calendar months that all user accounts... are correct..." [cite R-c4.3] | "LSPG shall conduct reviews of individuals with active electronic access, unescorted physical access, and associated authorization records, including BCSI access, on a quarterly basis and at least once every 15 calendar months." [cite O-884f2646] |

**Latitude Statement:**
The operator is using less latitude than NERC grants. While CIP-004-7 R4 Part 4.3 permits a verification interval of up to 15 calendar months for electronic access, your internal work instruction narrows this to a quarterly requirement (every 3 months) for both electronic and physical access, as well as BCSI access.

Cited sections:
- csection-e9450f7ad3b69f962c90 (CIP-004-7 R4 Part 4.3)
- isection-884f2646b20d13ba3a7d (LSPG Electronic and Physical Access Review Work Instruction 3.1.1)
